mapper.select: SELECT source_type, source_id, title, content FROM ( ( SELECT 'script_version' AS source_type, version.id AS source_id, version.version_title AS title, version.content_snapshot AS content, version.create_time FROM ai_script_version version WHERE version.id != #{currentVersionId} AND version.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND version.deleted = 0 ORDER BY version.create_time DESC LIMIT 100 ) UNION ALL ( SELECT 'source_analysis' AS source_type, source.id AS source_id, source.title, source.editable_copy AS content, source.create_time FROM ai_source_analysis source WHERE source.editable_copy IS NOT NULL AND source.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND source.deleted = 0 ORDER BY source.create_time DESC LIMIT 100 ) UNION ALL ( SELECT 'viral_asset' AS source_type, asset.id AS source_id, asset.asset_name AS title, asset.script_text AS content, asset.create_time FROM ai_viral_asset asset WHERE asset.script_text IS NOT NULL AND asset.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND asset.deleted = 0 ORDER BY asset.create_time DESC LIMIT 100 ) ) candidates
